summary: Rounds 4 & 5 tested (backend pytest + Playwright UI). Hampers: 4 cards with correct prices, items, sizes. No-size add shows error toast; with a size it adds to cart. Buy Now goes to /checkout. Full demo checkout with 2 hampers succeeded (MV68503067, total 5198) and tracking shows it. The cart link for a hamper goes to /hampers. The hero model showcase has 4 models, rotates by itself (~3.8s), dots work, the name updates, and Shop this look goes to the product page. It fits at 1920 and 390 with no horizontal overflow, and the headline is fully visible. The home hamper banner links to /hampers, nav-hampers works, and the footer reads '© 2025 Matra Vastra'. The /download button points to {BACKEND}/api/download/source. The zip (717KB, 112 files) has backend/frontend/scripts/memory, no node_modules, and only .env.example files. Each collection has 8 cards with visible prices and the correct price-range badge. /shop shows 24, all 6 new product pages load with no broken images, the sitemap has 36 URLs including /hampers, and there were no page errors.

minor.issue: Zip includes backend/.ruff_cache (3 files); add '.ruff_cache' to ZIP_SKIP_DIRS. Cosmetic.

issues: Side model cards are clipped at the screen edges (intentional carousel peek; acceptable)

action_items: Optional: add '.ruff_cache' to ZIP_SKIP_DIRS in server.py
Optional: add data-testid to the cart item name link (cart-item-link-{slug})
critical_code_review_comments: create_order: hamper and product lookups share one slug namespace; a future product slug that matches a hamper slug would shadow it. Consider an explicit item type.
Hampers.jsx: api.get('/hampers') has no loading/error state (an empty list shows on failure)
Download endpoint is public and unauthenticated; it serves memory/test_credentials.md and backend tests. OK for the demo, but consider gating it in production.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Rounds 1-5 all pass. Set sessionStorage mv_intro=1 to skip the intro. The browser tool rewrites screenshot paths, so don't use f-strings in the screenshot path. The container clock reads Nov 2026, so the sitemap lastmod is 2026-11-17.
